content: Yesu ꞌina lugu Yelusalema ꞌena

ꞌEnega situꞌetuꞌe Yelusalema manuna ga ꞌasa gidalidi Betani ta Betipegi selabediya silogelogedo, nate ꞌoya Olibe ꞌagalaunaya, ta Yelusalema nuganidiya tupwana ꞌedasola. ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌeluwa ꞌigimi etunedi sena nidi gidalidi ꞌediya ma ꞌadi emataluwa,

ꞌigwae, “Watauya ꞌasa gote matamiya ꞌenaya, ta ꞌeguma waapwesa ꞌasa nina matanaya, yobai ꞌebweu waꞌitaloba kaiwe ꞌena silosipwena, nate ase mwaneyauna, tauna nigeya tomota sida gelu toona. Yobai nina waliꞌami be wameꞌe.
Ta ꞌabo ꞌebweu yaita ꞌienaida ꞌemiya be ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌase manuna nate yobai nina waliꞌaliꞌami?’ tai nina waeona, ‘ꞌInapwana nuwanuwana, be tuta kukupana namo be ꞌida etune ilenama.’ ”
ꞌEnega site luwa nidi sitauya ꞌasa nina ꞌenaya ga yobai ase silobena anuwa mataꞌawaninaya, ta kaiwe ꞌena silosipwena, ꞌenega sieꞌale be siliꞌami.
Siliꞌaliꞌami ta ꞌaina tomota sitootoolo selabediya sigwae, “Toꞌase manuna nate yobai nina waliꞌaliꞌami?”
Ta site luwa nidi sigwae, “ꞌInapwana nuwanuwana, be tuta kukupana namo be ꞌida etune ilenama,” ga ꞌediya sitagwalena.
Ta yobai nina siꞌewena ga sitauyena Yesu ꞌena, ga ꞌadi ꞌoamega gwauna siloesona, ꞌenega Yesu ꞌigelutuꞌe, ga ꞌitautauya.
Ta boda yaudi wate ꞌadi ꞌoamao ꞌedaya siesodi, ta ꞌaidi kaiwe nalidi mayawadi siguledi ꞌeda ꞌana eiyala manuna.
Ta ꞌaina boda Yesu sianuganena ta ꞌaina boda siamuliya, ga maiboꞌadi silotuputupu ta sibwaubwau, sigwae, “Kamatoki ꞌInapwana, Yaubada ꞌana esanega ꞌumai sabi ꞌetoseyema.
ꞌEbeloina tubumao Debida ꞌenega ꞌiapwesa limanama. Gete manuna Yaubada Toloetana sana ꞌatuputupu.”

Ga Yesu niꞌatu Yelusalema ꞌena ꞌiapwesa ga Anuwa Tabu ꞌena ꞌilugu, ga yage yauna Anuwa Tabu solanaya ꞌiduneyedi, ta niꞌatu ꞌasuinuwanuwa, ꞌenega ma ina tononoyao site tuwelo siila Betani ga nada siꞌeno.
Yesu kaiwe ꞌebweu ꞌibaꞌena
Ga tomwa ꞌiulisina ga sitoolo ga Betaniyega siilaila limana Yelusalema manuna, ta Yesu ꞌibotana,
ga ꞌedasolega kaiwe ꞌana ꞌita ꞌatuwa damaya mayawana ꞌiꞌitena, ꞌenega ꞌinao selabenaya be nuwanuwana ꞌaene uwanega ꞌida loepaꞌala, ta esi ꞌiꞌitena yawa daisinamo, tuga ꞌaweuwauwa maꞌetamo ꞌadi tuta.
ꞌEnega Yesu kaiwe nina ꞌibaꞌena ga ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wate ꞌuuwauwa limana be tomota ꞌenega siꞌeꞌai.” Ga ꞌina ona gete ꞌina tononoyao sinonona.
Yesu togimwane ꞌipaꞌidi Anuwa Tabu solanega

ꞌEnega Yelusalema ꞌena simai, ga Anuwa Tabu solanaya ꞌilugu, ga toegimwaneyao be togimwaneyao solanega ꞌipaꞌi apwesedi, ta mani ꞌana toesaꞌugelasao ꞌidi tebeli ꞌiꞌaubuiyedi, ta bunebune ꞌadi toegimwaneyao ꞌidi ꞌebemiya wate ꞌiꞌaubuiyedi.
Ta wate anuwa solana ꞌiegagalena be geyaꞌabo tomota ma idi gwegwe sitautauya anuwa solanega.

Ga ꞌieꞌitedi ꞌigwae, “Nai Buki Tabu ꞌena Yaubada ꞌina ona siꞌetoladina wamwalatonina, ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌIgu anuwa sida eese anuwa ꞌebe sidasida tomota maiboꞌadi manudi,’ ta ꞌomi wagibunina ga ꞌaene ꞌimi ꞌebe ꞌipwala.”

Ta totaliyao sinabwadi be loina ꞌana toeꞌitao Yesu ꞌina guinuwa gete tetelina sinonona, ꞌenega sigamwasowalena ga sinuwa edaedadama be sida loemwawasi, ta nigeya sawesawediya, manuna simatautena, ta wate Yesu ꞌina eꞌitao tomota yauyaudi nuwadi ꞌiꞌewena.
Ga niꞌatu ꞌiboi, ꞌenega Yesu ma ina tononoyao ꞌasa nina siebesinena.
Kaiwe nina Yesu ꞌibaꞌebaꞌena ꞌiꞌoapelu
Ta tomwa ꞌiulisina ga sitoolo sabi ila Yelusalema, ga ꞌedaya sitautauya, ta Yesu kaiwe nina ꞌibaꞌebaꞌenaya siꞌitena niꞌatu yawana maiboꞌana siꞌoapelu.
ꞌEnega Pita Yesu ꞌina ona ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisina ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌuꞌita kaiwe nina ꞌubaꞌebaꞌenaya niꞌatu ꞌiꞌoapelu.”
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEguma ꞌimi emisa wasaꞌu Yaubada ꞌena, ꞌomi wate ꞌimi guinuwa waiwaidi wada guinuwedi.

Wate yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya ꞌeguma yaita ꞌoyo nigeya ꞌuda enuwanaluwa ta esi ꞌuemiemisa be toꞌase ꞌuda ona sida apwesa tuga, ꞌeguma ꞌoya gote ꞌuloine be ꞌugwae, ‘ꞌUmiya dolo olaya,’ ꞌimu ona ꞌida ematamatane tuga.
“ꞌEnega yaeonami toꞌase waside Yaubada ꞌena, wada emisa tuga be maꞌetamo wada loba.
Wate ꞌabo wasidasida Yaubada ꞌena, gosemiyao ꞌidi loegesiyao wanuwataudi ꞌabo toꞌase ꞌidi bubuna ꞌemiya, be gete ꞌenega Tamami galewaya ꞌomi wate ꞌimi loegesiyao ꞌida nuwataudi.”
Yesu ꞌina loina manuna
ꞌEnega niꞌatu siilama Yelusalema, ta Yesu Anuwa Tabu solanaya ꞌiadadana, ga totaliyao be loina ꞌana toeꞌitao be wate ꞌinapwanao simai,
ga Yesu sienaidena, sigwae, “Tai, yaita ꞌina loinega ga gete nadigega ꞌuguiguinuwaꞌesa?”
Ga Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Nugana yagimi enaida ꞌemiya be ꞌeguma waeꞌisa, ꞌaboꞌagu wate yaeonami ꞌigu loina manuna.
ꞌIgu enaida gete: Yaita ꞌina loinega ga Yoni togiebapitaiso ꞌiguiguinuwa? Yaubada, nai ꞌebweu tomota?”
ꞌEnega taudimo ꞌediya siegewagewana, sigwae, “ꞌIna ona mwaꞌadega taeꞌisaꞌese? Manuna ꞌabo tagwae, ‘Yaubada ꞌenega,’ ꞌiabe ꞌieona limada be ꞌigwae, ‘Ta! Toꞌase sana manuna ga Yoni nigeya waemiemise?’
Ta ꞌeguma tagwae, ‘Tomota ꞌenega,’ ꞌiabe pwalu sigamwasowaleda.” Manuna tomota yaudi Yoni siemisena ꞌaene tauna palopita ꞌaiꞌaila.

ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina enaida nigeya sieꞌieꞌisa ꞌaiꞌaili, ta esi sigwae, “Nigeya ꞌamwalamwalatoni.” Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu geyaꞌabo wate ꞌemiya yasimasimana apwesa yaita ꞌina loinega ga gete nadigega yaguiguinuwaꞌesa.”
